commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Stuart Attwell has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' It looked like the long-range shot by Shea Lacey (Manchester United) would end up in the net, but the effort went painfully wide of the right post. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time.
90+5' Lyle Foster (Burnley) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
90+2' Substitution. Marcus Edwards walks off the pitch and Oliver Sonne (Burnley) comes on as a substitute.
90+2' The attendance for today's match is 21047.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
88' 7:29 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
88' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
88' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
85' Shea Lacey (Manchester United) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball onto the bar. Nice run, but unlucky finish!
84' Here comes a substitution. Shea Lacey (Manchester United) is brought on as a substitute for Manuel Ugarte.
83' Lucas Pires (Burnley) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
83' Burnley can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

81' Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) receives a lofted pass and is given time inside the box to unleash a shot goalwards. The ball is directed towards the left side of the goal, but it lacks power and Martin Dubravka pulls off a comfortable save to thwart the effort.
80' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) was too forceful with his tackle and Stuart Attwell interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
78' Leny Yoro (Manchester United) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards wide of the left post.
78' An attempted cross from Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) is cleared.
76' Substitution. Lyle Foster (Burnley) in, Armando Broja out.
74' Darren Fletcher has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) replacing Casemiro.
74' The referee signals a substitution. Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) is brought on as a substitute for Matheus Cunha.
72' Manchester Utd are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
68' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle after Luke Shaw (Manchester United) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Burnley have a free kick from a promising distance.
66' 2 - 2 Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) controls the ball with an excellent first touch on the edge of the penalty box after receiving a splendid pass and smashes the ball into the top right corner!
65' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
64' Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United) makes a rough challenge and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul.
63' Burnley hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Leny Yoro (Manchester United) comes onto the pitch for Ayden Heaven.
61' Darren Fletcher has decided to make a change. Mason Mount (Manchester United) replaces Bruno Fernandes.

60' 1 - 2 Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) meets a perfect cross from Patrick Dorgu deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike inside the right post. The score is 1:2.
58' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
58' A substitution has been made. Hannibal Mejbri goes off and Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) comes on.
57' Ayden Heaven (Manchester United) rises above the defence to meet the corner. His timing is good, but he arrows his header just a few inches wide of the right post.
57' Manchester Utd have been awarded a corner kick.

56' Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Manchester Utd have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
56' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) throws the chance away as he attempts to produce a shot from inside the box. His attempt simply rattles the right post. The goalkeeper can remain calm.
55' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner which is cleared.
54' Burnley failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
53' Armando Broja (Burnley) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders. Burnley have a corner.
50' 1 - 1 Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets inside the left post.
47' Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

45+1' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom left corner, but Martin Dubravka has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

44' What a chance that is! Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
44' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
43' Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
41' Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley) sees a yellow card from Stuart Attwell after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.

41' Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it to the middle of the goal, but Martin Dubravka makes a comfortable save to stop his effort.
39' Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Burnley have been awarded a free kick.
38' A long pass, executed by Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
38' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
37' A crossfield pass from Maxime Esteve (Burnley) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is behind the touchline and Manchester Utd will take a throw-in.
35' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United).
32' Lucas Pires (Burnley) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
32' Neat passing move from Burnley in order to create new attacking opportunities.
29' Celebrations are cut short for Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United) as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review due to a foul in the build-up play.
28' Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United) puts the ball into the back of the net, but referee Stuart Attwell immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.
27' Manchester Utd win a corner.
27' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player. The ball is out of play and Manchester Utd manage to earn a corner.
26' Lesley Ugochukwu (Burnley) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent. Manchester Utd earn a free kick.
25' Manchester Utd enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
21' Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
21' Good movement by Casemiro (Manchester United), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
19' Great teamplay by Manchester Utd as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
16' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
16' Casemiro (Manchester United) brings an opponent down and Stuart Attwell interrupts the game.
13' 1 - 0 Goal! Hannibal Mejbri plays it to Bashir Humphreys (Burnley), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Senne Lammens. 1:0.
10' Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.

9' Lucas Pires (Burnley) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession. The ball has crossed the sideline. Burnley are taking a throw-in.
8' Manchester Utd seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
6' A cross by Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
3' Josh Laurent (Burnley) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. It's a throw-in for Manchester Utd.
